balls.text: Slower bouncer just outside off. Spongy bounce. Ngidi hops and slaps it to deep-backward point's left
Vipraj doesn't farm strike after the run out. Pulls the short ball in deep midwicket's direction, so, no chance for two

Another miss, another bye attempted. This time they go through with it and Starc will be run out. Sent upstairs, puzzling as he was well short despite the bowler taking time to hop across and push the ball into the stumps. Was a fuller, wider ball that was beyond Starc's reach as he got low and went for the square drive
Beaten, bye attempted... Non-striker sent back. Full ball landed around off and angled away, Starc got low and tried to drive it through cover

Rahane catches a bullet at the edge of cover. Takes a couple of steps back due to the momentum. 148ks full ball just outside off, Ashutosh was back in the crease and muscled a cover drive. Didn't follow through fully but powered it well. Placement was the issue
Gets across and gets bumped. Inside the line he was, beaten on the check-pull. Goes off the shoulder to square leg
Flat-bats it straight back. Well over the bowler and the ring. Slower short ball angling away from around the wicket. Ashutosh standing just outside off giving him reach

Cutting-edge reverse sweep, with the full follow-through and it's middled over the deep-third fence. Fullish length ball from around the wicket at 140ks landing outside off and angling further away. Ashutosh opens his stance fully, lunges a touch and swings with a wide, horizontal arc
Slower short ball just outside off, Vipraj jumps and cuts it to deep-backward point

Anukul takes a stunner at deep midwicket.. He ran to the left, was running at pace while taking the catch to the left, around waist-height. Foot stuck in the ground for a moment and he fell into the ground but never lost hold of the ball. Slower ball into the pitch just outside off, pulled flat.

Two shots to one ball. Ashutosh planted his front foot far across and Vaibhav, from around, darted it wide and full. So, the shot was adjusted. Ashutosh stopped the ramp midway and slapped it to deep cover
Makes room and gets followed by a pacy full ball. Flicked to deep midwicket
Axar belts it... straight to deep point. Wide ball on a length. 120ks
Slow again, Ashutosh reads it. Pulled nicely but straight to deep midwicket. This was just outside off and around shoulder height
Tries, mistimes. Back leg lunged as he drove the full ball off the inside-half to long-on
Slow bouncer this time. Just outside off, pulled to long-on

Top skill from Ashutosh. Knows the length will be short, so he stays in the crease in front of off. The ball is just outside off and around shoulder-height. He twists the bat in a way that its toe points to deep third as he finishes ramping it very fine. No chance for deep third
Good bowling. Bowled to his field. Dug it very short and outside off. 143ks. Ashutosh pre-meditated, charged down and went for the full-fledged cut. Misses
Over the wicket but same line and length. Very wide and on the shorter side. Legbreak but fast. Cut but not with as much power, finds deep point .

Other side of cover this time, beaten to the left on the edge of the boundary. Ashutosh using the crease this time, goes right back and essentially steers the length ball after it passes his back leg. Bowler's conference on

Defensive bowling, attacking batting. 101ks ball on a length, lands outside off and goes further away. Skids at an even pace. Ashutosh was standing just outside off, leant across and cut it through cover
38-ball boundary drought is over. Slot ball has been pumped over the sightscreen. 110ks ball around off, Ashutosh clears the front leg, gets slightly low and swings through the line
Misses out. Ashutosh gets on one leg, leans across and steers the very wide length ball straight to backward point
Length on leg, flicked to long leg. Varun hobbles back again
DC just about see off Narine. Axar hangs back and is early on the flick as the wide length ball spun back in sharply and kept a touch low. Gets it to midwicket and brings up the team hundred
Goes back and tucks it across to midwicket. Thinks of two, not on
Length on middle, back-foot driven to midwicket
Strong appeal for lbw, not given. No review. Front-of-the-hand back-of-length ball lands just outside off and spins in sharply. Beats the defence, hit him on the knee roll. Umpire's call on Hawk-Eye
Length on off, spins in at 91ks. Looked slow. Punched to the off side
Ashutosh is glued to the crease till the point he punches the length ball to cover. Got carried away with the momentum
Length on middle, Axar shaped to turn it leg side. Kept the bat straight and brought it low, ball went off the sticker to backward point
Pitched up on off, punched from the crease to long-on
Shortish ball angles away wide. Ashutosh reaches with his upper body for the back-foot square drive. Misses. 143ls. Bluff in line from Tyagi
Fullish length ball on leg, 148ks. Axar unsure, had to be as that bounced low. This time he bends his back to jam it. Thick outside edge goes to cover. Quick single
This one skids through with even bounce. 142ks length ball on fourth stump hurries Axar to beat him. He looked to scissor a drive to deep third
Low bounce again. Length ball on off skids low, Axar gets his hands down with a vertical bat to guide it to point
Lack of timing saves Axar. He looked to thrash the full ball through the line. Plinked it into the outfield, rolls to long-off. DC take the timeout
Big bounce this time. 96ks length ball lands on off and finishes over middle. Axar is taken aback, manages to sway back and bunt it from around chest-height, to point
Bit of turn in and low bounce. 95ks length ball just outside off. Axar collapses as he cuts it late towards short tird
Goes back to a fullish ball on leg, 94ks, defended towards cover
Length on middle and leg, punched to long-on. Varun limping back to his mark though
Length on leg, flicked to midwicket
Length on off, stays beside the ball and punches it off the back foot to long-off
Length ball but very wide, cut straight to deep point
Length on off, grips and turns away. 94ks. Punched off the back foot to long-off
Length on leg, punched to cover with no footwork. Stood tall though

Keeper convinced that was strangled down leg. Umpire signals wide. KKR review. Raghuvanshi convinces Rahane. Stock ball on a length lands on leg and goes with the angle. Ashutosh, on the crease, misses the leg glance. Ball tickles the trouser. Review retained as it will be wide. Slightly lucky there, KKR
Length on leg, flicked through midwicket
Message, it seems, was to stonewall. Ashutosh squares himself up, jams the feet and goes back in the crease. Defends the shortish ball right in front
Fuller ball on leg, flicked to square leg
Length on leg, defended to cover. Looked slow
Mystery. Axar not sure if it'll spin or go straight. Gets stuck in the crease, stays upright and pokes away from the body. Ball doesn't turn but bounces big. Beaten
Length on off, defended to cover
Axar searches... and misses. Fullish length ball lands around off and straightens, 89ks. Axar got forward and looked to defend straight. Outside edge beaten
Length on off, punched to cover

Stump-to-stump does it. 95ks length ball from around the wicket skids through and hits top of off. Stubbs' back foot was planted, front leg cleared coast and he tried to punch it to cover. Ended up poking and missing . Two in the over for Anukul
Sticks in the pitch and spits up. Length ball on middle and off, Stubbs clears his front leg and checks his shot as he punches to cover
91ks length ball around off, driven off the back foot through cover
Length on middle, flicked through backward square leg
Down leg, shortish ball spins in and beats the pull

Action replay... goes wrong, and Nissanka walks back. Sent upstairs, not sure if it was needed. Ultra-Edge also being checked. No edge. Miles out. That's a couple of minutes wasted. Nissanka danced down, looking it to slap it through extra cover again. Anukul likely saw him and went much shorter and slower, landed in line with the tramline around a back of length. Nissanka cut hard, found thin air as the ball spun away and bounced nicely. Will be wide but out
Dances down and slaps it through extra cover. 29-ball fifty for Nissanka. Get to the pitch, that was the name of the game. There was ample width too
sharp turn for the ball coming in, surprises Stubbs a little but he blocks
some loop, a big sweep and he's holed out to deep midwicket! Rizvi's laborious night comes to and end as he goes for a mighty sweep but doesn't get the distance as Powell settles under it
slightly shorter and this time he does well to pull it wide of long on, calls for two early
that turns away and Rizvi had no clue! Cemented on the back foot and that took the outside edge
a premeditated sweep after reaching a fair bit outside off, gets one square of the wicket
some width to start with and he dabs it late to short third
finally Rizvi gets bat on ball as he gets width too and defends it late towards slip
Nissanka reads him much better and clips the ball turning in to leg for one
beaten three times in a row! Rizvi looking clueless here. A bit more towards leg, similar length and Rizvi might have an edge there on his pad and they hare across for one to get him off strike
oh beaten again! Similar delivery coming in, he can't read it off the hand or pitch, and Varun belts out an appeal but the umpire says no again
beaten first ball! Rizvi doesn't get bat as the ball sneaks through the bat and pad gap. The half-appeal is turned down for lbw
quite straight to Nissanka and he works it to leg for one
soft dismissal and Rana is gone! It was a short ball angled into him and his timing is all over the place. Late on the shot, he gloves it behind to short fine leg
angling in, cramps him up for room and Rana defends it back

Rana realises he needs some runs too! He gives the charge, Green delivers it wide and outside his arc, and Rana does well to reach out and get the outer half to send that flying to the deep third boundary after a bounce
goes well outside off now without much pace and Nissanka punches it to deep cover
flicked for six! N for Nissanka, N for non-chalant. That was fullish on the stumps, a bit too straight and Nissanka nails that flick over fine leg
starts with a fair bit of room and Rana cuts it away to deep point
a hint of room and Nissanka cleverly late cuts it fine wide of short third for four
a bit too full and he drives it back to Varun
soft hands again from Rana for Varun, tucks the ball from middle to long on
much shorter and turning in again, pulled away in the air to deep midwicket
turning in towards the front leg, he can't put it away
just outside off from good length, he turns it to leg for one
off the mark with some luck! He cuts that short bal over point, deep point comes running in but it lands well short and Rana gets one and retains strike
swing and a miss! Three dots in a row for Rana as he gets one angling away outside off and can't connect
length delivery on the pads this time, clipped to midwicket gently
140.6kmh, angling away from length with a slip in place and hello! Rana has shouldered arms
126.3kmh, not much pace and short too, Nissanka middles that pull to deep midwicket
flicked just over short fine! Poor ball on the leg side, Nissanka didn't have to do much apart from flicking it with the angle and the pace, and it beat Varun's leap at the edge of the circle

skies it right up and Rahul is gone! Rahul swings big, doesn't middle it at all and that goes high into the night sky. These catches are never easy, but Cam Green at mid-on has his eyes glued to the ball and catches it with the reverse cup
slapped back! Short with width outside off, and Rahul slams it straight back to beat mid off for four more
short and a hint of room, he scythes that wide of point and gets a quick one
not a bad ball at all but Nissanka slams it back and can't clear mid on
a delicate dab for the tighter line wide of short third for one
cuts the wide ball wide of point and Anukul Roy slides, makes it in time but he can't keep the ball in either! He got both hands to his right and will think he should have saved it there
92.7kmh, straighter one towards middle and leg, worked to long on off the back foot
93.4kmh, a tad too short, which gives Rahul enough time to go back and pull it away wide of long on for four more! Green gives it a side in the deep but can't keep it in
straightens towards middle and leg, clipped square for one
this one turns in and Nissanka blocks on the back foot
Nissanka is on a roll! He leans into that length ball outside off and caresses it along the ground with the turn for four! Must have read it off the hand
Rahul waits for the ball to turn, sees it come in, and whips it to leg for one
too short again like in the first over and Nissanka again is quick to hop on the back foot and heave it away for six!
he comes down to make it a low full toss, drives it back and Roy gets his right hand to it
95.9kmh, a quick yorker and Nissanka does well to dig it out
93.6kmh, fires it in towards middle and leg, Rahul hangs back and pushes to cover for a quick single
he connects this time with the fuller delivery on leg, and clears mid on easily for a one-bounce four! Big swing, nice and easy
Rahul wants to go big on leg but miscues to mid on
Fuller side of length around off, 132ks, knocked behind point solidly again
Wrong line again, no damage. Length ball just down leg, Nissanka misses the leg glance and it deflects off the thigh to square leg
Uses the angle to launch it fine. Touch back of length and angling in to the left hip. Nissanka stays in the crease, gets upright and flicks it with the weight on the back foot
Length on off, good ball. Rahul waits and angles to bat to knock it towards backward point
Pitched up at the stumps, punched neatly to mid-on
Seam in? Might not be, was a touch slow off the pitch. Back of length just outside off, Nissanka looked to punch it with a slightly open face, inside edged it to the leg side of the pitch
Touch short and rises to top-of-stump height, Nissanka rocks back and shovels a pull to long-on
Tossed up and full on middle, driven to long-off
Full toss has been flicked to short midwicket
88.4kmh, slower, fuller and on middle, he drives it down gently to long off
and off we go! Shorter this time and towards leg too, Nissanka rocks on the back foot in a flash and pulls it away to the vacant midwicket boundary
flat and quick just outside off, he cuts to point
Make it four, with a six! Allen pick-up pulls it off a back of length over midwicket. Hugs his partner, lid comes off. KL congratulates him
Yep, Green goes back and glances the short-of-length ball to deep fine leg
Wanted to hit it out of Delhi. Went back in the crease and pulled it with might, too early on it though and toed the length ball to the bowler's left
Allen mercilessly dispatches Kuldeep now. Pitched up outside off, Allen takes a big stride forward and brings out the big slog sweep for a big six over midwicket
Nutmegged? Yep, not French cut. Allen went back in the crease and looked to whip it square again, got it to fine leg
Goes back and works it to midwicket.
Length missed, ball flies. Googly is too full and too wide. Allen took a small step forward and used his hands to reach out, not ideal, but this time he muscles it with a flat-bat over long-off
Fullish length ball on middle and leg, goes back and flicks to deep-backward square leg
Length on leg, clipped through square leg
Length on middle and leg, twirls the front leg out of the way and punches to long-off
Third six in a row. Back over long-off again. Axar's double-teapotting. Legbreak is a touch too full and on the same line as the second ball. No spin this time, same shot pretty much
Good ball punished like it was trash. Flat length ball on top of middle and leg, Allen goes back in the crease, then square-on and pulls it over square leg
Looped up, flighted into the stands. First tier six over long-off. 86 metres. This was full and just outside off, Allen got low and slashed with the spin
Goes back and works the length ball, against the spin, to long-on
Flat and quick. 87ks but looked quicker. At the stumps, Green wanted to work it leg side. Gets it to long-off. Close to the leading edge. Went along the ground
Allen coils back as he cuts hard.
87ks length ball just outside off, chopped off the bottom-half to cover
Green is much more comfortable on the pull. Over midwicket again. Kuldeep's exasperated. This was shortish too, at the stumps, came off the pitch at an easy pace.
Fuller side of length just outside off, chopped to long-off. That one spun in and skdded

Googly has been pulled over deep midwicket. Kuldeep did miss his length, erred on the shorter side, but at 83ks, the ball just failed to get off the pitch. Allen reached forward and was early on the shot, doesn't matter
Low full toss just outside off, driven along the ground to Stubbs' left at long-off. He splashes the ball in front as he was running full tilt as he got behind it. Does well to save two
Proper toe-job. Allen too early into the pull as the slow short ball spins away from him. Gets it to long-on. Starc smiles
Short of a length slower ball just outside off. Green in great position for the pull, gets it to deep square leg
Dropped. Tough chance, driven hard to Axar's left. Not as sure on replay actually, ball may have half-volleyed to him.
Half-volley just outside off, munches a drive but straight to long-on

Scrambling scoop to bring up fifty. Pre-meditated, banking on getting pace on. Allen went back in the crease and side-crawled across the crease, got inside the line of a length ball and got it over fine leg
quick on the back foot again, push down to long on for one
makes a bit of room to scythe that one for one more
stays back for this one at 95.7kmh and carves it wide of point for two in the gap
Green looked unsure whether to come down or stay back and eventually defended it back
fuller on middle and this one's driven to cover
darts one towards middle, Green defends it back
134.9kmh, full on the stumps and Green charges down to slam it down to long off for one
he gets it in the block hole now, and Allen digs it out for one
pace outside off, another single for Green to deep point, this one with a drive
116.8kmh, slower ball dipping towards the block hole well outside off, he drives it down to long off
138.6kmh, back to pace on and Allen swings but can't clear midwicket
slower ball it is on short of length outside off, Green scythes to deep point for one
googly to end the over too, Green waits deep in the crease and defends

pulled straight down to long on, Stubbs runs in but he's put it down! It wasn't an easy catch at all because the ball was dipping on him, but he did manage to get his hands on the ball before putting it down
generously flighted and that's smashed into the sight screen! Too full as well apart from the flight, and he middled that straight loft
well outside off, this had to turn towards the batter, who defends it back
edged for four off the wrong'un! This one turns the other away from off stump, Allen punches away and only gets a thick edge but there's no slip and Allen gets four
flat and quick from Kuldeep too, Allen slams it to midwicket
a wrong'un to end the over, Green stays back and adjusts just in time for one with a late cut
much quicker and flatter, he cuts it away for one
straight as an arrow and six more! Too straight, too full and Allen cashes in with a straight loft 92 meters away
flat to Allen as well, but this one has enough room for Allen to free his arms with a cut square of the wicket and beat a diving deep point for four
short and flat to Green, who hangs back and turns it to leg for one
slightly loopy outside off and driven away to long off
much slower at 83.7kmh on middle stump, he goes back yet again and tucks it to leg for one
on the back foot, darted on off, defends it just in time
makes a hint of room for the length ball on off, punches down to long off for one
pitched up and that's disappeared into the stands! The ball is lost, not kidding you. Right in the slot and Green used his long limbs to get to it easily and send it 94m away over wide long on
watches carefully and defends on off
on the back foot almost immediately, and clips the ball to leg for one
shorter and angling in towards the body, he defends with a straight bat
angling in just outside off, pushes to cover with a front foot stride
tight lines at 137.1kmh, he taps the ball to off and takes off for one
lovely drive on the up for the full delivery outside off, but straight to mid off
135kmh, quick and angling in, he nudges it to midwicket
pace on to start with, movement off the pitch too and Green steers the ball square to off after it seamed away
86.7kmh, some pace off for the fourth stump line, he punches straight to cover
off the mark straightaway with a punch to deep cover

what a bizarre dismissal! And Raghuvanshi is gone too. Raghuvanshi goes for the sweep and doesn't connect but the ball goes off his arm and lobs up, and then bounces and rolls back to hit the stumps while Raghuvanshi tries to spot the ball and then attempts to move it away but it's too late
skidding towards top of middle, Allen works it to leg for one more
92.3kmh, fuller on the stumps and Raghuvanshi opens up to drive through cover
flat and quick on the stumps, he defends on the back foot

run out at the non-striker's end! Drama in Delhi. Starc is pumped even as Allen apologises to his partner. Starc goes for the Inswinging yorker, Allen slams it back because it's not really in the block hole, Rahane is a couple of steps out and Starc gets his left hand on the ball which hits the stumps at the other end
hint of inswing and that takes the inside edge of the bat to fine leg
flicked with such flair! The peach is followed by one on the pads and Rahane is not going to let that go. Flicks it all the way into the stands with a flourishing swing of the bat
141.9kmh beaten! Test match stuff from Starc - stifling line outside off, excellent bounce and pace and Rahane pokes and misses
Starc goes for the inswinging yorker but it's a low full toss, still not a bad ball. Allen drives it wide of mid off but Axar does well to get a hand to it with a dive
134kmh, not his usual pace outside off and that gives Allen enough time to stand back and punch that through cover point, right in the gap for four
goes on the back foot again and Allen also whips the ball from outside off to leg for one
outside off and he turns it to leg for one more
makes room and carves that through the covers! Four more. There was turn this one for the ball turning away from off and Rahane backed away further to free his arms further
slower to Rahane on middle and leg and angling in with the arm, he nudges to leg
stays back again and works it down to long on for one
amazing shot! Not that short, but he hops on the back foot and almost scoops it over the midwicket region with a back-foot loft to find the boundary
hint of late swing for the full ball on off at 143.3kmh, inside edge to leg for one
bashed down the ground for four! More in his range, no swing really for the length ball and Allen barely moves his feet but smashes the ball back past mid off
beaten! Full and wide, pretty wide, in fact. Allen goes down on a knee and tries to reach for it but misses.  Just inside the wide line
in the air, one bounce to deep third! Short and wide, good bounce and Rahane upper-cuts that over the backward point region. Off the mark
139.4kmh, more width for the fullish ball outside off, he middles the drive down to mid off
fourth stump line outside off on good length, Rahane pushes at it and gets an inside edge to midwicket
